# Relations

<!-- Generated from the feature manifests. Do not edit by hand:
     edit <feature>.manifest.ts, then run `npm run docs:reference`. -->

What `selection-display` needs on the page, what it is normally used with, and what breaks it.

## Dependencies

- [`package-selector`](../../../cart/package-selector/guide/overview.md) — it shows whatever the named selector currently has selected, so a `selection.*` binding resolves to nothing without one on the page.

## Conflicts

None known. Several instances of this feature can coexist on a page.
